scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @cac/server" "npm run dev -w @cac/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p shared && tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p web && tsc --noEmit -p e2e
scripts.test:be: vitest run --project be-unit --project be-ft --project be-e2e --project contract
scripts.test:fe: vitest run --project fe-unit --project fe-ft && npm run test:e2e:web
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && vitest run && playwright test
